protocol: E3 provenance: source digest, front-end flags, cache explanation
source_digest_method: sha256 over sorted file list + contents of eth80_frontend.py, parameters/_text.py, perception/contour_field.py, perception/contour_peak.py, orchestration/binder.py, matching/joint_mcs.py, matching/relation_frame.py, core/registries.py, _bootstrap.py
source_digest_note: Cache state was reset between sessions; the digest is recomputed over the current working tree. The earlier-session digest was 530ee3e9...953f2ca. The front-end flag defaults below are the operative ones.
flag_defaults_note: FE_L3_SPINE, FE_L4_JUNCTIONS, FE_SUBPIXEL_PEAK_POS, FE_L6_ADDRESS, FE_VECTOR_ADDRESS default OFF. BINDER_COMPLETE_POSITION_MAP defaults ON (root-cause fix for CONTOUR_PEAK positioning). The arms B0/B1/F set these flags explicitly via _bootstrap.apply_switch_overrides.

cache_explanation.mechanism: The front-end caches perceptual graph pickles keyed by a field_fingerprint that folds switch overrides but NOT default flag values. When BINDER_COMPLETE_POSITION_MAP default changed from False to True, 41 cache entries with the old default-spec digest (fdf6f145dbf562d8) became stale: they were built with the old positioning behavior.
cache_explanation.resolution: The 4c held-out build rebuilds all 240 graphs with explicit arm overrides, so stale cache entries are superseded. The cache is content-addressed by (image sha256, field_fingerprint); any mismatch triggers a rebuild.
cache_explanation.cache_state_note: Front-end cache was reset in a later sandbox session. All held-out and ref graphs were rebuilt from source with explicit arm overrides, so no stale entries remain in the current results.
